title: Government Web-Property Registry — Entity Record
description: One record describes a government / public-authority ENTITY (not a single domain). The schema is steward-neutral and standards-aligned (Popolo, W3C ORG, schema.org/GovernmentOrganization) so any municipality can adopt it. An entity carries an opaque stable id, a coarse government-level classification, parent/child links, a list of web properties it has owned over its life, external keys as scheme-based identifiers[], geographic references by pointer (areas[], never embedded geometry), legal mandates, and succession relations. NYC/NYS-specific choices (id syntax, scheme catalog, boundary service, canonical dataset) live in configuration and docs, not in this schema. Scheme values are documented in docs/schemes.md and are addable without a schema change. EAC-CPF crosswalk: docs/eac-cpf-crosswalk.md.

id.description: Opaque, stable, steward-neutral key. Lower-case slug of [a-z0-9-]; no steward name or prefix is embedded (the retired BNYC-ORG-NNNNNN form is preserved as an identifiers[] entry with a legacy scheme). Immutable, never reused. The exact id syntax is a CONFIGURATION choice a fork may change (see docs/schemes.md § id); this pattern is the reference NYC/NYS convention.

name.description: Official / preferred name of the entity (Popolo `name`).

short_name.description: Common short name or acronym (e.g. 'MTA'). Convenience field; historical/alternate names belong in other_names[].

other_names.description: Alternate, former, or variant names (Popolo `other_names`; EAC-CPF <nameEntries>). Populated during name-variant resolution; never inferred by fuzzy matching.

government_level.description: Coarse classification. This enum is part of the NYC/NYS CONFIGURATION layer (a fork adjusts the values); it is not steward-branded. nyc = NYC city entity; nys = NYS state executive agency; bi-state = jurisdiction spans NY and another state (e.g. PANYNJ); authority = public authority (state/local/IDA/LDC); pbc = public-benefit corporation. authority and pbc overlap by design; `classification` carries the finer legal-instrument detail. See docs/schema.md.

classification.description: Finer legal / organizational classification (Popolo `classification`; formerly `entity_type`). Free-text or upstream-derived, e.g. 'public-benefit-corporation', 'mayoral-agency', 'local-development-corporation', 'public-university'.

parent_id.description: id of the parent entity (e.g. the MTA is parent of LIRR / Metro-North / NYCT / TBTA), or null for a top-level entity.

child_ids.description: ids of subsidiary entities. Bidirectional with parent_id.

identifiers.description: The interoperability core (Popolo `identifiers`). Every external key is a {scheme, identifier} pair — new upstreams add SCHEME VALUES, never new fields. Scheme values are documented in docs/schemes.md and are addable without a schema change (deliberately NOT enum-locked here). Values are populated ONLY when verified against the upstream — never invented (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

scheme.description: Documented scheme name (e.g. 'nyc_goid', 'wikidata', 'us_irs_ein', 'nys_abo', 'archive_org', 'snac_ark'). See docs/schemes.md for the catalog: authority, format, verification rule.

identifier.description: The value of the key within its scheme (e.g. a MODA record_id, a Wikidata QID, an EIN). Stored verbatim as a string.

web_properties.description: The registry's core novel contribution: the domains/subdomains an entity has owned over its life, each with a validity window. A list because entities accrete and retire domains. Also the Internet Archive join surface — the Wayback Machine keys on URL+timestamp, so each domain (incl. legacy) is a CDX query key and its validity window scopes the expected capture range (docs/schemes.md § archive_org).

domain.description: Registrable domain or subdomain (e.g. 'mta.info', 'web.mta.info'). Not a full URL and not a path.

role.description: primary = the entity's current canonical site; legacy = a retired/superseded host; microsite = a campaign/sub-brand site.

valid_from.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the property came into use, or null if unknown.

valid_to.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the property was retired, or null if still active / unknown.

url_conventions.description: Per-era path patterns under a domain (the harvester reads these to know WHERE under a domain documents historically lived).

era.description: Year range the pattern applied, e.g. '2003-2020'.

areas.description: Geography by REFERENCE only — geometry is never embedded (a fork points at its own boundary service). Each entry links the entity to a district/area in a documented geographic scheme. See docs/schemes.md § nyc-boundaries and § us_census_geoid.

scheme.description: Documented geographic scheme, e.g. 'nyc-boundaries' or 'us_census_geoid'. See docs/schemes.md.

layer.description: Layer code within the scheme. For 'nyc-boundaries': the map's published layer ids (cd, cc, sa, ss, nycongress, zipcode, pp, dsny, fb, sd, ed, bid, nta, puma, ...). For 'us_census_geoid': the summary-level name (e.g. 'county', 'place').

id.description: District/area id within the layer; null for a whole-layer reference (an entity that operates the entire layer).

role.description: operates_layer = the entity administers a whole district system (NYPD→pp, DSNY→dsny, DOE→sd, FDNY→fb); jurisdiction = the entity's own footprint (a community board→its one cd; a borough president→a borough).

area_note.description: Free-text note on geographic extent, especially where an entity EXCEEDS the available boundary layers (MTA's 12-county region, bi-state PANYNJ, statewide agencies) and no clean areas[] reference exists. Names a candidate external geometry source; no geometry is stored. Use areas[] for machine-readable references.

mandates.description: The legal authority that created or empowers the entity (term and concept from EAC-CPF <mandate>). Generalizes the former established_by_eo[] — an executive order is one authority_type. Citations are text + URL; the registry does not embed statute text.

citation.description: Human-readable citation of the instrument (e.g. 'NYC Charter § 20', 'Public Authorities Law § 1263', 'Executive Order 42 (2019)'). For an executive order migrated from established_by_eo[], the locked eo_id is carried here.

url.description: Resolved live-or-Wayback URL of the instrument's source document (for an EO, the former source_pdf_url).

date.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the instrument took effect, or null.

role.description: How this instrument relates to the entity's life.

relations.description: Succession relations to other entities (concept from EAC-CPF <cpfRelations>). Seeded from former-names data and curated during archive work; never inferred by fuzzy matching. Supersedes the former succeeds_ids / succeeded_by_ids fields.

type.description: predecessor_of: this entity is the predecessor of target_id. successor_of: this entity succeeds target_id (e.g. OTI successor_of DoITT).

date.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the succession took effect, or null.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Removals/renames from an upstream are recorded as status changes + dissolution_date, never silent deletes.

founding_date.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the entity was established, or null (Popolo `founding_date`; EAC-CPF <existDates> from-date).

dissolution_date.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the entity was dissolved/merged/renamed, or null if still active (Popolo `dissolution_date`; EAC-CPF <existDates> to-date).

links.description: Related URLs that are not owned web properties (Popolo `links`) — e.g. an enabling-legislation page, a Wikipedia article. Owned domains go in web_properties[].

contact_details.description: Contact points (Popolo `contact_details`). Optional; Greenbook-derived contact scaffolding lands here in phase 2, with staleness flagged in `note`.

provenance.description: Which upstreams asserted this record and when it was last verified, so a hand-curated record and an auto-synced record are distinguishable.

sources.description: Upstream(s) that asserted this record. This enum is part of the NYC/NYS configuration layer (a fork adjusts it). `greenbook` marks a record carrying Greenbook-derived contact scaffolding (staleness flagged in the contact_details note).

last_verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) this record was last verified.
